Why Cryo Traveler Isn't a Good Off-Field Support for Mitya | Genshin 7.2
description:
Why isn't Cryo Traveler a good off-field support for Mitya in Genshin Impact 7.2? The answer comes down to how their Elemental Skill works during Stellar-Conduct.

When Stellar-Conduct is active, Cryo Traveler's little floating ice star no longer fires automatically. It only fires when the Traveler hits enemies with Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks.
